Game Overview

Hide and Seek in Block Craft is a escape game built around race to build a bridge using scattered blocks while outsmarting opponents who aim to disrupt your progress. Rescue allies to bolster your construction efforts and choose wisely—defeat a dragon with dynamite or heal it. Defend yourself from relentless zombies with strategic block placement. Unleash your creativity and cunning!

How to Play

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Hide and Seek in Block Craft is easy to pick up. Race to build a bridge using scattered blocks while outsmarting opponents who aim to disrupt your progress. Rescue allies to bolster your construction efforts and choose wisely—defeat a dragon with dynamite or heal it. Defend yourself from relentless zombies with strategic block placement. Unleash your creativity and cunning!
